title: Music City, Tiny Living
description:
WELCOME TO MUSIC CITY!

You are going to love your trip to Nashville!

The tiny house is located on my property, but it is separated by a privacy fence. You would have the entire house to yourself. There is a small yard and deck out front for your use. There is a private entrance/parking for you as well. 

Close to all the hot spots! Broadway, GEODIS Park, Vandy/West End and the Airport are just a few minutes drive away!  Quiet neighborhood. 

There is a lock box for you to gain access.

The space
The tiny house is in an established neighborhood with friendly people. You will have everything you need; microwave, Keurig, dishwasher, counter top oven, refrigerator, bath tub and shower. Lofted bedroom with queen size bed. There is a Smart TV downstairs and upstairs. You have access to a private deck just outside the front door.
